- center: W

Unless... the handle position changes the base color? Let me test this more carefully.

- g tiles cycle: g → N → g → N...
- W tiles cycle: W → N → W → N...

What if the goal is to have all tiles in the same state (all N or all g/W)? Let me try making all tiles N.

    print(f"  {k}: {tiles[k]}")
